scenarios.contract: ACK covers the complete binding-scoped typed Protocol Coverage in the selected primary WAL
normal admitted append performs zero remote control-metadata reads and mutations
uncertain and fenced completions converge without duplicate protocol-position success
Topic Protocol Binding is immutable, profile is immutable within a Storage Epoch, and operational policy remains mutable
one immutable TopicBindingAggregateRecord physically owns the complete binding and initial epoch
Kafka Offset and Pulsar Position remain binding and incarnation scoped typed domains without a universal logical offset
Pulsar Object WAL uses explicit virtual Ledger Chain authority while Object identity never becomes a position
virtual ledger IDs increase inside non overlapping never reused cell slices excluded from native allocation
one Storage Fabric hosts independent Kafka and Pulsar Protocol Cells without shared position or write authority
cells sharing physical provider infrastructure retain distinct provider scopes, sessions, namespace and security scope, and lifecycle
Object WAL groups never cross Protocol Cells and cell-local throttle, credential, drain, or close faults cannot mutate another provider session
shared worker, cache, and GC capacity cannot cross cell queue, task, cache, publication, or physical-delete authority
0.2 creates one initial Storage Epoch per Topic Incarnation, preserves the append-only typed-cut model, and rejects a second append-admitting epoch
0.2 retains projection and migration identities only for topology validation and cannot grant a second Native Write Authority or production runtime capability
Object WAL ACK waits for verified group durability and SHA256 v1 over the canonical request body
one stalled binding cannot block an unrelated binding's typed Durable Frontier
lost PUT response accepts only version bound SHA256 FULL_OBJECT provider proof or bounded full GET
CRC32C v1 covers exact assigned Kafka batch bytes or exact Pulsar ManagedLedger entry bytes after outer Object decode
both BookKeeper profiles ACK at quorum without synchronous Object dependency
ManagedLedger metadata is sole Pulsar async offload authority and 0.2 offloads sealed non current ledgers only
Kafka BookKeeper layout passes 10k and 100k partition resource spikes
one sealed Pulsar ledger attempt uses one bounded data Object plus one deterministic sparse index root Object
manifest publication exposes one binding-scoped typed logical view with protected source fallback
logical trim and physical GC revalidate every protocol and source protection
KRaft and MetadataStore backends satisfy fencing and monotonic-root conformance
missing stale or corrupt typed handoff hints fall back to bounded durable recovery
Kafka Object profile passes exact-source AutoMQ non-regression and advantage thresholds
Pulsar BookKeeper path passes exact-source native feature and performance parity
KoP design remains present and explicitly deferred from 0.2 runtime and release gates
